title: Create production Dockerfile, nginx.conf, and wire docker-compose.yml
description:
Create react_ui/Dockerfile, react_ui/nginx.conf, and modify docker-compose.yml to add the UI service.

react_ui/Dockerfile (multi-stage build):
- Stage 1 (build): FROM node:20-alpine AS build. WORKDIR /app. COPY package.json package-lock.json or npm-shrinkwrap.json ./. RUN npm ci --only=production && npm install typescript. COPY . . RUN npx vite build.
- Stage 2 (serve): FROM nginx:alpine. COPY --from=build /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html. COPY react_ui/nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf. EXPOSE 80. CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"].

react_ui/nginx.conf:
- server block listening on port 80
- location /: root /usr/share/nginx/html; index index.html; try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html (SPA fallback)
- location /api/: proxy_pass http://backend:8000; proxy_set_header Host $host; proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr; add_header X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN
- gzip on; gzip_types text/css application/javascript application/json image/svg+xml

docker-compose.yml:
- Add a 'ui' service: build context ./react_ui, dockerfile Dockerfile. ports: "3000:80". depends_on: backend. environment: NODE_ENV production.
- Do not modify any existing services. Only add the ui service block.
- Preserve all existing indentation, formatting, and service definitions.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docker-compose.yml (if it exists — to understand existing service definitions and formatting)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
